objective: Quantify how Physical Halation's edge-replicated box diffusion changes with frame dimensions and spread, separating absolute frame-edge amplification from the radius-to-frame-size ratio.

scope.effect: PhysicalHalation source-equation highlight extraction and dual-layer box diffusion; focus is frame dimension and boundary response.
scope.method: Offline Float32 separable source-equation model, using the production clamp sampling and integer radii, with one neutral HDR point on opaque black frames.
excluded: transparent edges, colored inputs, photographic scenes
display transform, transfer conversion, or output clamp
physical film equivalence or aesthetic acceptance

comparison.baseline: Same frame dimensions and spread with the point source at the geometric center; also report an unbounded translated-kernel reference when radius fits inside the frame.
candidates: spread values 5, 15, 50, and 100, within the declared property range
point at frame center, midpoint of each edge, and each corner
comparison.ground_truth: None. This is an equation-response characterization; equal-energy unbounded kernel is an explanatory reference only.
comparison.acceptance: No visual-quality pass/fail. Verify source markers, alpha identity, finite nonnegative fields, mirror symmetry, and expected scaling from separable 1D responses. Report total layer energy and edge/center ratio, peak, centroid displacement, support, radius/frame ratio, and frame coverage. Do not infer a defect from amplification alone.

materials.fixture: Locally generated Float32 BGRA opaque black frame with a single neutral source pixel B=G=R=4 and alpha=1.
materials.identity: Record plan, runner, core source and wrapper source hashes, dimensions, settings, source positions and all metrics.

regions.edge_profile: 1D horizontal and vertical response through source coordinate

conditions.source_positions: For every dimension/spread: center, midpoint of left/right/top/bottom edges, and four corners.
conditions.numeric_domain: Float32 direct numeric values; no display transform or clamp; opaque alpha 1.
conditions.equation: Apply source Rec.601 luma and soft-knee highlight weight, producing B*.1, G*.2, R. Apply one horizontal and one vertical edge-clamped box pass at integer radii int(spread*red_diffusion) for red and int(spread) for green/blue. Compute 2D field statistics from one-pass separable 1D impulse responses.
metrics: red and green/blue layer sum and center-relative amplification ratio
unbounded-kernel energy reference when support fits
support width and fraction of frame touched
alpha identity, finite values and output range
conditions.display: Locally generated heatmap of red energy amplification versus radius/frame ratio and a profile plot; metrics remain authoritative.

effect_correctness.method: Check source and wrapper markers and compare the separable model against clamp-box equations.
effect_correctness.acceptance_criteria: All fields finite/nonnegative; exact opaque alpha preservation; mirror RMSE <= 1e-6.

image_quality_and_detail.method: Inspect amplification heatmap and selected normalized profiles.
image_quality_and_detail.acceptance_criteria: No aesthetic or physical realism judgment.

color_and_alpha.unverified: Colored/transparent materials and compositing over multiple backgrounds.

temporal_stability.reason: No time-varying parameter or random field.

performance.reason: Offline equation model, not production execution.

evaluation.decision: No defect classification, product quality acceptance, or implementation approval.

execution.backend: Python NumPy offline equation model; no Windows UI, app, build, CMake, or test execution.
execution.reproducibility: Fixed settings, dimensions, point positions, source equations, output metrics and SHA-256 hashes.

amendments.reason: The first exploratory execution reused a 1D helper that applied two sequential box passes on the same axis. The production source performs one horizontal and one vertical pass. The helper was corrected to one pass per axis; corrected comparisons replace the exploratory output before any interpretation.
amendments.effect: Corrected source-equation model; scope and acceptance criteria unchanged.
